data.body: [P2] Approach: Include the required JavaScript integration coverage. CONTRIBUTING's pull-request requirements 3 and 5 require integration tests and an examples-package update for a public feature. This test manufactures the hook and SUSPENDED transition, and no changed example exercises suspendAfter. The reported Python cloud run does not validate this JavaScript worker/session implementation. Return to the design phase under rule 8 and include a runnable example with integration coverage for suspension and resume across durable replay.
